title: Activists occupy Microsoft data centre construction site in Amsterdam
seoTitle: Amsterdam protest at Microsoft data centre

tea.why: Activists oppose the construction of a massive Microsoft data centre due to its immense energy and water consumption and impact on housing.
tea.want: Demonstrators demand an immediate halt to the data centre project and express opposition to Big Tech, AI, and military technology links.
tea.changed: Nov 6: Riot police intervened and cleared the site after dozens of activists breached the fences and occupied the Microsoft construction area.

summary: On November 6, 2026, activists breached the perimeter and occupied the construction site of a planned Microsoft data centre in the Sloterdijk district of Amsterdam. The action was organised by the climate and justice group Geef Tegengas and joined by Extinction Rebellion and pro-Palestinian demonstrators. Protesters scaled fences, construction cranes, and scaffolding, hanging banners and Palestinian flags while voicing opposition to Big Tech, artificial intelligence, and Microsoft's alleged ties to military operations. Organisers stated that hundreds entered the grounds, while police and witnesses reported roughly one hundred to five hundred participants. Authorities deployed riot police, used pepper spray, and began clearing the site and arresting protesters, resulting in at least one minor injury to a police officer.
demands: Stop construction of the Microsoft data centre
Halt resource-intensive AI and big tech infrastructure
End ties between technology companies and military operations
response: Police intervened with riot units, pepper spray, and conducted arrests to clear the site after protesters breached the perimeter. A Microsoft spokesperson stated the company respects peaceful expression of opinion but does not condone unlawful actions that put safety at risk.

crowd.text: about 500 people had entered the site

injuries.text: Bij het protest raakte een agent lichtgewond.

updates.text: Activists breached fences, climbed cranes and roofs, and occupied the Microsoft data centre construction site in Amsterdam.
Riot police deployed to the Sloterdijk area, used pepper spray, and began clearing the site while making arrests.
